description: 覆盖 Elsevier 通用稿件、研究数据、贡献、披露和投稿材料要素；具体期刊作者指南仍优先。
descriptionEn: Covers common Elsevier manuscript, research-data, contribution, disclosure, and submission-material elements; journal-specific author guidance still takes precedence.

submissionElements.label: 论文标题
submissionElements.description: 核对标题准确、简洁并符合具体期刊文章类型。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify that the title is accurate, concise, and suitable for the journal's article type.

submissionElements.label: 作者与单位
submissionElements.description: 核对作者顺序、单位映射和通讯作者信息。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify author order, affiliation mapping, and corresponding-author details.

submissionElements.label: 摘要
submissionElements.description: 核对摘要结构和字数是否符合具体期刊要求。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify the abstract structure and word limit against the journal guidance.

submissionElements.label: 关键词
submissionElements.description: 核对关键词数量、术语和投稿系统录入要求。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify keyword count, terminology, and submission-system entry requirements.

submissionElements.label: 利益冲突声明
submissionElements.description: 提供与投稿系统披露一致的利益冲突声明。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Provide a competing-interest statement consistent with the submission-system disclosure.

submissionElements.label: 资助声明
submissionElements.description: 核对资助机构、项目编号和相关角色。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify funders, grant identifiers, and relevant roles.

submissionElements.label: 作者贡献声明
submissionElements.description: 按期刊要求核对 CRediT 或其他贡献说明。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify CRediT or another contribution statement as required by the journal.

submissionElements.label: 数据可用性声明
submissionElements.description: 说明研究数据是否可用、获取方式或不能开放的理由。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: State whether research data are available, how to access them, or why access is restricted.

submissionElements.label: 伦理与同意
submissionElements.description: 涉及人或动物研究时核对伦理批准和必要同意。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: For human or animal research, verify ethics approval and required consent.

submissionElements.label: 投稿附信
submissionElements.description: 核对研究意义、原创性、相关材料和伦理信息。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify significance, originality, related materials, and ethics information.

submissionElements.label: 图表与题注
submissionElements.description: 核对图表位置、题注、单独文件和复用许可。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify figure/table placement, captions, separate files, and reuse permissions.

submissionElements.label: 补充材料
submissionElements.description: 核对补充文件命名、引用和上传要求。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify supplementary-file naming, citations, and upload requirements.

rules.message: 请再次核对具体 Elsevier 期刊的 Guide for Authors、文章类型和上传附件要求。
rules.messageEn: Recheck the selected Elsevier journal's Guide for Authors, article type, and upload requirements.
